title: Soup loop paraphrase record
description: Stable paraphrases of the prompt of an answer a person corrected, appended to .soup-loops/paraphrases.jsonl (default layout), one line per edited answer. A later model version is asked the paraphrases (not the original prompt) to check whether it learned the correction. They are generated once per answer and reused so every version is checked against the same questions. They are never training data. Readers use the last line per response_id in file order. If no paraphrase survives the generator's filters, no line is written. Readers ignore unknown fields.

response_id.description: The `id` of the conversation record (the edited answer) whose prompt was paraphrased.

prompt_hash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the normalised prompt: the conversation record's messages (without the answer) serialised as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace (separators , and :), non-ASCII characters written as themselves, encoded as UTF-8. soup_cli.utils.loop_formats.prompt_hash computes it. A reader recomputes it to see whether the prompt of the answer is still the one that was paraphrased.

paraphrases.description: Rewordings of the prompt. May hold fewer items than were requested: the generator drops a paraphrase that normalises to the original prompt or contains the words the correction added, after one retry.

model.description: The model that wrote the paraphrases.

template.description: The instruction template the model was given.

dropped.description: Optional. How many generated paraphrases were dropped by the generator's filters.

dropped_reasons.description: Optional. Why paraphrases were dropped. same_as_prompt: it normalised to the original prompt. leaks_answer: it contained the words the correction added.

^x_[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.description: Producer extension namespace (x_<app>). Soup never reads or rewrites it.

uuid.description: A UUID in canonical lowercase form.

utc_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, suffix Z or +00:00.
